title: PaleoMAP PaleoCoastlines data, version 7.1
citation: Kocsis, A. T., and Scotese, C. R., 2021. Mapping paleocoastlines and continental flooding during the Phanerozoic. Earth-Science Reviews, 213, 103463. Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.4297693

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.statement: The Zenodo record lists cc-by-4.0 and Data/Readme.md in the archive states 'Licence: CC-BY 4.0'.

contents: Data/CS: coastline polygons at 81 ages, 0-535 Ma, in reconstructed coordinates (shapefile and GPML). Data/CM: continental margins, the -1400 m isobath of the PaleoDEMs. Data/paleomap_model_v19o_r1c: the PALEOMAP rotation file and partitioning polygons they were made with. Equirectangular and Mollweide PNG and PDF plots.
evidence: Coastlines start from the PALEOMAP PaleoDEMs and are moved to the maximum transgressive surface indicated by stage-level marine fossil occurrences in the Paleobiology Database.
status: Collected for review; not used by the viewer.
